UI_GunpartTooltip_EnableCompact_tooltip: Use compact custom tooltip for weapon parts with many mount points
UI_GunpartTooltip_ShowMountList_tooltip: Display weapon compatibility list in gunpart tooltips
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_general: Configure general behavior of the weapon system.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_weapon_sounds: Adjust shooting and reload sound volume separately.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_new_gunshot_tool: Toggles the enhanced layered gunshot sound system. When disabled, the game uses the default weapon sounds.
UI_options_AWCWF_weapon_shot_volume_tool: Batch-adjusts the volume of every gunshot sound.
UI_options_AWCWF_weapon_reload_volume_to: Batch-adjusts the volume of every reload sound.
UI_options_AWCWF_shell_casing_volume_too: Adjust the volume of shell casings hitting the ground. 0 mutes it, 0.5 is the default, and 2 is double volume.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_effects: Configure muzzle and shell-ejection effects independently from weapon sounds.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_muzzle_smoke_too: Show muzzle flash and smoke when firing. Disable to hide this visual effect.
UI_options_AWCWF_enable_shell_ejection_t: Eject spent shell casings that fall to the ground. Disable to stop spawning casings.
UI_options_AWCWF_desc_handgun_grip: MFS pistol models were built around a body replacer with smaller hands, so on the default game body the pistol can sit slightly behind the hand. These settings correct that. Rifles are not affected.
UI_options_AWCWF_handgun_grip_body_repla: Tick this if you use VSGirlBody mod. VSGirlBody then use the pistol position the models were originally built for, Leave unticked if you use the default game body.
UI_options_AWCWF_handgun_grip_offset_too: How far forward the held pistol sits in the hand. 0.03 suits the default game body. Set 0 to use the model position unchanged. Handguns only.
UI_options_AWCWF_debug_all_attachments_t: When enabled, shows every weapon attachment in the inspect window without requiring a known recipe. Debug mode only.
UI_options_AWCWF_keybind_grenade_launche: Key to fire an attached grenade launcher while aiming.
UI_options_AWCWF_keybind_inspect_window_: Key to open the weapon inspection window.
UI_options_AWCWF_keybind_tactical_stance: Key to toggle tactical stance mode.
UI_options_AWCWF_keybind_light_mode_tool: Key to cycle the laser/light mode of the equipped weapon.
